The reflection-pair data for topological spaces: neighbourhoods, topologies, continuous, reflecting, initial and embedding maps
Continuous maps contain the identities, are closed under composition and have topologies at both ends
Reflecting maps contain the identities, are closed under composition and have topologies at both ends
The initial maps of topological spaces are exactly the continuous reflecting ones
The topological embeddings are exactly the injective initial maps
Continuous and continuously reflecting maps form a reflection pair, with both cancellation laws
